S62.04.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in, on a plan that has at least two cloud models
S62.04.note: The pill shows the provider name from the model registry; I did not verify which plans get two models, only that the screen says so when they do not.
steps: Sign in and switch the chat to AGI Cloud mode (Local Mode shows a notice and no compare command).
In the message box type "/" and tap "compare" in the list that appears.
On the "Compare Models" screen, look at the pill labelled A and the pill labelled B, separated by "vs".
Check that each pill shows a model name and, under it, the provider name, and compare with Expected.
S62.04.where: Chat > type "/" in the message box > "compare" > the "Compare Models" screen, read the two model pills at the top (name, then provider name under it)

S62.05.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in, with two cloud models
S62.05.note: Status is shown per panel only as text and small stat chips; the code has no separate status screen.
steps: Open "compare" from the "/" list as in S62.04.
Type a short prompt in the message box and send it.
Watch each panel while it works: the panel shows "Generating..." while its model is streaming.
When an answer finishes, check the panel shows its status (ms to first token, approximate tokens, total time) and compare with Expected.
S62.05.where: Chat > type "/" > "compare" > type a prompt and tap send > watch panel A and panel B on the "Compare Models" screen

S62.06.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in, with two cloud models
S62.06.note: No separate transcript view was found; each panel's own answer text is the per-agent transcript.
steps: Open "compare" from the "/" list.
Send a prompt and wait until both panels stop showing "Generating...".
Scroll the screen and read the answer text inside panel A, then inside panel B.
Check that each panel shows only its own model's answer and compare with Expected.
S62.06.where: Chat > type "/" > "compare" > send a prompt > read the text inside panel A and panel B on the "Compare Models" screen

S62.07.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in, with two cloud models
S62.07.note: The "Faster" tag only appears after both answers finish.
steps: Open "compare" from the "/" list and send one prompt.
Wait until both panels finish.
Read panel A and panel B separately, each with its own answer.
Look for the "Faster" badge on one panel or "tie" in the model pills, and compare with Expected.
S62.07.where: Chat > type "/" > "compare" > send a prompt > read each panel's result and the "Faster" or "tie" tag on the "Compare Models" screen

S62.09.needs: an AGI Cloud account with AGI Work, and two or more tasks running at once
S62.09.note: The list is a single view of all runs; the section headers come from the code's time grouping.
steps: Open the side menu and tap "AGI Work" (shown only in AGI Cloud mode on a plan that includes AGI Work).
Start two or more tasks, or use tasks already running.
Tap the filter chip "Running" to see only running tasks.
Check that several running tasks appear together in the list, each with its state label, and compare with Expected.
S62.09.where: AGI Work (drawer) > Filter chip "Running" > task cards in one list, grouped under "Today", "Yesterday", "This Week" or "Older"

S62.10.needs: an AGI Cloud account with AGI Work, and at least one task waiting for input or approval
S62.10.note: The default "All" list is not reordered: it sorts by last activity time (runPresentation.ts), so waiting tasks are first only through the "Needs you" filter.
steps: Open the side menu and tap "AGI Work".
Tap the filter chip "Needs you" to show only tasks that wait for you.
Check that tasks in "Waiting for input" or waiting for approval are listed, and compare with Expected.

S62.11.needs: an AGI Cloud account with AGI Work, and a task waiting for input or for approval
S62.11.note: The approval buttons take their words from TOOL_APPROVAL_ACTION_LABELS; I did not confirm the sheet closes or stays open after an answer.
steps: Open "AGI Work" from the side menu and tap the filter chip "Needs you".
Tap a task card that shows a waiting state.
If the sheet shows "Waiting for your approval", tap "Approve" or "Deny". If it shows an input form, fill it and tap "Send answer".
Check that the task updates while you are still on the task list behind the sheet, and compare with Expected.
S62.11.where: AGI Work (drawer) > tap a task card that is waiting > in the detail sheet, answer with "Send answer" or tap "Approve" or "Deny"

S62.12.needs: an AGI Cloud account with AGI Work, and a task that has run
S62.12.note: No separate full-transcript screen was found; the sheet shows the stored transcript, which the store trims to a maximum length (apps/mobile/src/features/tasks/store.ts).
steps: Open "AGI Work" from the side menu.
Tap any task card.
Scroll the detail sheet to the section "Latest output" and then to "Activity".
Check that the task's output and activity lines match the task's history, and compare with Expected.
S62.12.where: AGI Work (drawer) > tap a task card > in the detail sheet scroll to "Latest output" and "Activity"

S62.19.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in
S62.19.note: In Local Mode the screen shows a notice instead of the comparison.
steps: Sign in and switch to AGI Cloud mode.
Type "/" in the message box; the command list appears.
Tap "compare".
Check that the "Compare Models" screen opens with two model pills, A and B, and a message box, and compare with Expected.
S62.19.where: Chat > type "/" in the message box > "compare" > the "Compare Models" screen with two model panels

labels.text: Your plan runs one answer at a time, so the second waits for the first.

S62.20.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in; a plan that allows two answers at once to see true parallel answers
S62.20.note: Whether the two answers really arrive at the same time depends on the plan's concurrency limit (runsOneAnswerAtATime in compare/index.tsx), which I did not check against the plan table.
steps: Open "compare" from the "/" list.
Type one prompt and tap send.
Check that panel A and panel B both show "Generating..." at the same time.
On a plan that allows one answer at a time, check that panel B shows "Your plan runs one answer at a time, so the second waits for the first." instead, and compare with Expected.
S62.20.where: Chat > type "/" > "compare" > type a prompt and send > both panels show "Generating..." together on the "Compare Models" screen

S62.26.needs: an AGI Cloud account, signed in, with at least two cloud models
S62.26.note: Choosing a new model clears the current comparison; the picker offers only the cloud models the plan allows. The picker's own title text was not found.
steps: Open "compare" from the "/" list.
Tap the pill labelled A (or B) at the top of the screen.
A model picker sheet opens; choose another model.
Check that the pill now shows the new model's name and that the choice is kept for the next prompt, and compare with Expected.
S62.26.where: Chat > type "/" > "compare" > tap the model pill A or B on the "Compare Models" screen > choose a model in the picker sheet
